description: Review of contemporary approaches to micro-hydropower design and implementation is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Isaac Duah. This dataset contains the csv file exported from SCOPUS for research works between 2014 and 2024 on the design and implementation aspects of micro hydropower systems. It also contains the BibTex file exported from Mendeley for all references used in the review titled "Review of contemporary approaches to micro-hydropower design and implementation.". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
